candidates.body: Ruby and Tyson added a mascot clause to their closing routine: the bakery cannot be locked until the mascot is confirmed to be out of the building.
candidates.narrative_gravity_note: Creates a practical rule that can be tested once a mascot exists, especially if its form or responsibilities become unexpectedly complicated.

candidates.body: Tyson proposed installing a tiny warning bell for anyone reaching for the bakery door without thinking, though Ruby dismissed it as charming only briefly.
candidates.narrative_gravity_note: Preserves a possible recurring prop or joke about Tyson’s overengineered response to being locked out.

candidates.body: Ruby admitted she would be deeply embarrassed if the eventual bakery mascot proves better at closing than she and Tyson are.
candidates.narrative_gravity_note: Sets up an easy comedic payoff if the mascot later exposes or corrects a closing mistake.
